root.law: AOSP graphics/Canvas.java: Canvas(Bitmap)/setBitmap bind the canvas to a bitmap target with its OWN matrix/clip/save state; every op rasterizes eagerly INTO that bitmap; the canvas stays live until release().
root.fix: per-canvas sub-recorder (same op laws, isolated matrix/clip/save state) + eager flush into BitmapStore after each op (replay over a temp SoftwareCanvas wrapping the bitmap pixels, copy-in/copy-out); sync_shared_state mirrors Paint/Path state; re-arm capturing_ after each flush; getWidth/getHeight answer bitmap dims; bind of unknown/empty bitmap = honest warn_noop.
root.second_root_same_wave: flush originally left the sub-recorder dead: replay() ends with capturing_=false (view-frame lifecycle law) so ops after the first flush were dropped (probe row R2 exposed it). Fix: re-arm capturing_=true after every flush (a bitmap canvas is not a frame).
